claims.statement: Tom Allen refereed the wrestling match between Carteron and Rigal at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis, which went undecided after a severe struggle on Tuesday evening.
claims.excerpt: Owing to the Great Wrestling Match betweer CARTERON and RIGAL having peen undecided or Tuesday evening, after a severe struggle

claims.statement: Tom Allen ruled that the match between Carteron and Rigal would have its final decision on Thursday evening, February 10, 1876, at the same hour and place.
claims.excerpt: the great match shall have its tinal decision on THURSDAY EVENING

notes: Refereeing only; no bout of Allen's own. The hint's 'the decision on Thursday' matches the text.
